name: btp-named-user-propagation
description: BTP Named User Propagation — CAP + UI5 reference implementation for cross-subaccount named user principal propagation on SAP BTP CF
//workspaces: npm workspaces: srv = CAP handler (Cloud SDK deps), router = AppRouter (@sap/approuter)

scripts.//start: Production start — used by MTA/CF (cds-serve reads srv/ via CDS conventions from root)
scripts.//dev: Local dev: starts CAP backend + AppRouter concurrently. Requires: npm i -g @sap/cds-dk
scripts.//build: CF deployment: requires mbt (npm i -g mbt) and CF CLI logged in
scripts.deploy:cf: cf deploy $(ls mta_archives/*.mtar | head -1) --retries 0 -f $([ -f environment-variables.yml ] && echo '-e environment-variables.yml')
scripts.build:deploy:cf: npm run build:cf && npm run deploy:cf

//dependencies: @sap/cds lives at root so cds-serve resolves srv/service.cds from project root
//devDependencies: concurrently powers 'npm run dev' — not deployed to CF
//cds: CDS auth config: xsuaa in production, dummy (no-auth) in local development
